candidates.change_summary: Change the required caller from the fixed address to any address (remove require on msg.sender) so transfer can be called by others, affecting return behavior when original would revert for non-owner callers.
Change the multiplication factor for v to 1 (remove 1e18 factor), altering the amount sent to caddress and thus potentially changing whether calls succeed and the returned boolean behavior.
Invert the success check to revert on success rather than on failure, making previously successful sequences revert (changing observable return).
